rules: Never animate a flattened full-scene image as component-level motion.
Always audit scene topology before build.
Always identify every major element that needs independent movement.
Request missing critical assets before build.
Allow reconstruction only when source fidelity can be verified.
Allow a flattened image as environmental background or explicitly approved flat-motion animatic.
Flat motion requires explicit user authorization.
A Remotion template never bypasses Layerability Gate.
READY_FOR_HUMAN is blocked while critical assets are missing.
